package.description: A free, open-source application for downloading and managing your Audible audiobooks. It decrypts your library, removes DRM, and lets you own your audiobooks forever.

en.description: A free, open-source application for downloading and managing your Audible audiobooks. It decrypts your library, removes DRM, and lets you own your audiobooks forever.
en.name: Libation
en.releaseNotes:
Fix bug introduced in 14.2.3 and 14.2.4.
Libation is a free, open source audible library manager. Decrypt, backup, organize, and search your audible library
I intend to keep Libation free and open source, but if you want to leave a tip, who am I to argue?
